fields.title: Build a Budget
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Target for the catalog screen is 1.2 s at p95. Known: connection already established, RTT 120 ms, rendering 200 ms, response transfer 150 ms. Break down the remainder into server calls: catalog, stock, prices, banners — and state what runs in parallel.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: leaves 1,200 − 120 − 200 − 150 = 730 ms for the server, minus a 15% reserve (110 ms) = 620 ms. Catalog, prices, and banners are independent — parallel. Stock depends on the product list from the catalog — sequential after it. Critical path: catalog (300) + stock (250) + assembly (40) = 590 ms. Prices and banners fit within the parallel 300 ms. A 30 ms reserve is a bit tight, should trim the catalog.
